newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BARCELONA WILL NOT TRANSFER NADAL TO MANCHESTER UNITED.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BARCELONA WILL NOT TRANSFER NADAL TO MANCHESTER UNITED.

text.p: Barcelona will not loan or transfer Spanish international defender Miguel Nadal to English champions Manchester United, the club said on Saturday.
"Nadal belongs to the first team and the club is not contemplating a transfer or loan of any kind," a club statement said.
Earlier both coach Bobby Robson and club vice-president Joan Gaspart voiced their opposition to the move.
"Nadal's staying. I don't want him to go, and we're not going to sell any players this season," said Robson. Gaspart called Nadal "untransferable".
On Friday Manchester United manager Alex Ferguson said he had re-opened talks with Barcelona for Nadal.
Chairman Martin Edwards said money was no longer an issue.
"We understand Nadal wants to join us and something could happen soon." Edwards said. "We are simply awaiting a call from Spain to tell us we can proceed with the transfer.
